summary: Diagnostics completeness still treats the mutable Workspace attribute UNRENDERED_RepresentedCount as authoritative. Even after consuming PR #349 exact-Instance ownership, a missing/reparented private-map representation can be hidden by lowering that model attribute, allowing the remaining exact owned children to satisfy the count fence. Replace this completeness authority with a narrow read-only count or id snapshot derived from the Realizer's private representation map; keep the model attribute observability-only.
evidence: PR #327 exact head acb728242741716487a5825542061d20f5c4bde4: directRepresentations reads model:GetAttribute('UNRENDERED_RepresentedCount') and accepts completeness when the enumerated direct-child count equals that Workspace value.

PR #349 exact head 901c063ff3c1e2584f84a07e1da3a9b1b82d413a: Realizer keeps the authoritative representations table private, computes representedCount(representations), and mirrors that count into the model attribute; the new ownsRepresentation seam validates each observed candidate but exposes no private-map count or id-set snapshot.

Source-level repro: with two authoritative F2 entries in the private map, reparent one owned Instance out of lab.model and lower UNRENDERED_RepresentedCount from 2 to 1. The remaining child can pass exact ownsRepresentation, uniqueness, fidelity, and the Workspace count equality while the missing private-map representation is never enumerated.

Repository PR search found #301/#327 treating UNRENDERED_RepresentedCount as authority and #349 solving exact candidate identity only; no current PR/lane replaces the Workspace count with a private-map completeness seam.

UNRENDERED architecture canon requires Workspace to remain physical representation rather than the canonical universe database; a diagnostic integrity fence should therefore derive authority from project-owned runtime state, not a mutable mirrored Instance attribute.

metadata.recommendedClosure: Expose a minimal read-only representedCount or representedIds snapshot from RealizedLab's private map, compare diagnostics enumeration against that authority, retain UNRENDERED_RepresentedCount only as observable mirrored telemetry, and add a pure regression proving a spoofed metric cannot hide a missing/reparented owned representation.
